core: DNA damage checkpoint and p53 regulation
qualifier: G2/M phase
name: G2/M DNA damage checkpoint and p53 regulation
rationale: Members cover Chk1/Chk2, Cdc25A, cyclin B-CDK1, PLK and MASTL events at G2/M together with p53 stabilisation and transcription after DNA damage; the G2/M focus separates it from G1/S, replication-origin and broad proliferation neighbours.

qualifier: glutamatergic and GABAergic, with sensorimotor gating behaviour
name: Enhanced glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission with sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members share positive regulation of excitatory and inhibitory neuron-neuron transmission plus prepulse inhibition and nonassociative learning, unlike neighbours about spine maintenance, receptor clustering, synapse assembly or general behaviour.

qualifier: MYC-driven, through pre-rRNA cleavage and subunit nuclear export
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and subunit nuclear export
rationale: Members span Pol I rRNA elongation, ETS/ITS pre-rRNA cleavages, ribosome assembly, subunit export and MYC target sets; the export/assembly and MYC components separate it from neighbours centred on general transcription machinery or RNA modification and decay.

name: Eating behaviour regulation
rationale: All three members concern feeding behaviour and its positive or negative regulation, whereas neighbours are framed through neuropeptide, leptin, appetite-response or sleep signalling.

qualifier: zinc, copper and toxic heavy metals rather than iron
name: Zinc, copper and heavy metal handling and detoxification
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper and manganese transport, metallothioneins, MTF1 and responses to cadmium, lead, mercury and cobalt, distinguishing it from neighbours built around iron, transferrin and heme handling.

qualifier: RNA polymerase III and I, with early pre-rRNA cleavage
name: RNA polymerase III and I transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members cover Pol III initiation, elongation and termination for tRNA and 5S rRNA, Pol I elongation and termination and ETS/ITS pre-rRNA cleavages; the Pol III arm separates it from neighbours centred on Pol I initiation, rRNA gene regulation and snRNA transcription.

qualifier: glucosyl donor supply and glucose/mannose trimming
name: Glucosyl donor synthesis and N-glycan trimming
rationale: Members link UDP-glucose and dolichyl-phosphate-glucose synthesis to N-glycan trimming (MOGS, MAN1B1) and oligosaccharide catabolism, unlike neighbours built around GlcNAc, mannose, sialic acid or the ALG lipid-linked assembly defects.

qualifier: cationic amino acid transport and arginine catabolism
name: Cationic amino acid transport and arginine-ornithine metabolism
rationale: Members cover arginine, lysine and ornithine transport (SLC7A7, SLC25A15), arginine catabolism and ornithine/citrulline metabolism, distinguishing it from neighbours centred on urea-cycle biosynthesis defects or glutamate/glutamine nitrogen metabolism.

qualifier: with axon-glial nodal and paranodal domain organization
name: Myelination and axon-glial nodal domain organization
rationale: Members combine CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance with L1-family/ankyrin interactions, paranodal junctions and sodium-channel clustering for action potential propagation, unlike neighbours on axon regeneration, gliosis or gap junctions.

qualifier: replicase maturation, RNA capping and host translation modulation
name: Coronavirus replicase maturation, genome replication and RNA capping
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation and maturation, genome replication, mRNA capping and IFIT evasion and host translation modulation, distinguishing it from frameshifting, influenza/RSV and HIV restriction neighbours.

qualifier: ATF6 branch
name: ATF6-driven chaperone induction in ER stress
rationale: All members concern ATF6-alpha/beta activation of chaperone genes, separating the theme from PERK/ATF4, IRE1/XBP1 and SREBP neighbours.

qualifier: glucose via ChREBP and sterols via SREBP
name: Glucose and sterol sensing transcription via ChREBP and SREBP
rationale: Members cover glucose-responsive (ChREBP, carbon catabolite, sugar signalling) and sterol-responsive (SREBP, cholesterol homeostasis) gene control, unlike neighbours driven by nuclear receptors, adipogenesis, motif sets or PKA/AMPK signalling.

qualifier: efflux from cells and drug response
name: Xenobiotic efflux transport and drug response
rationale: Members share xenobiotic export across membranes and the blood-brain barrier with responses to cisplatin, antibiotics and drugs, unlike neighbours on organic ion SLC uptake, bile acid secretion or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: cold- and diet-induced
name: Cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis
rationale: All members concern heat production in response to cold or diet, whereas neighbours concern adrenergic signalling, brown/beige fat differentiation or thermal pain sensing.

qualifier: ornithine-centred, with cationic amino acid transport
name: Ornithine-centred arginine and proline metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover ornithine, citrulline, arginine and proline metabolism plus arginine, lysine and ornithine transport, distinguishing it from neighbours on urea-cycle synthesis, glutamate/glutamine nitrogen handling or glycine conjugation.

qualifier: ligand secretion and receptor-level regulation
name: Canonical Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-level regulation
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion, FZD ubiquitination by RNF43, LRP5, DVL activation and ligand antagonists, unlike neighbours on the destruction complex, TCF/beta-catenin transcription or non-canonical Ca2+ Wnt.

qualifier: rods and cones
name: Visual retinoid cycle in rod and cone photoreceptors
rationale: All members concern regeneration of visual chromophore in rods and cones (including RDH5 loss), separating it from phototransduction cascade and general retinol metabolism neighbours.

qualifier: via p75NTR and dependence receptors
name: p75NTR and dependence receptor death signalling
rationale: Members share pro-death signalling by p75NTR (NRAGE, NADE, proNGF) and unliganded dependence receptors such as NTRK3, unlike neighbours on TRK survival signalling, p75NTR proteolysis or general apoptosis regulation.

qualifier: ATP-dependent, preventing aggregation, including ER folding
name: Chaperone-assisted protein refolding and aggregation prevention
rationale: Members concern ATP-dependent refolding, ER folding and suppression of inclusion bodies, distinguishing it from CCT/TriC de novo folding, heat-shock regulation and aggrephagy neighbours.

qualifier: translational repression and deadenylation-dependent decay
name: miRNA-guided translational repression and deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and silencing by translational inhibition and deadenylation of specific targets, unlike neighbours on regulation of miRNA processing and turnover or ceRNA/RNA-binding-protein stabilisation.

qualifier: VEGFR2 and Tie2 signalling
name: VEGFR2 and Tie2 signalling in sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members combine VEGF-VEGFR2 and Tie2 receptor signalling with endothelial proliferation, survival, migration and vessel branching, distinguishing it from neuropilin/lymphangiogenesis and negative-regulation-of-angiogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: estrogen receptor-centred
name: Estrogen-centred steroid hormone receptor transcriptional response
rationale: Members are dominated by estrogen receptor signalling and gene expression with HSP90 receptor cycling, progesterone and androgen response sets, unlike neighbours on androgen receptor/prostate programmes or GPER1 and estrous cycle.

core: Beta-catenin phosphorylation by the destruction complex
qualifier: oncogenic CTNNB1, AXIN and GSK3B mutants escaping it
name: Beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and its oncogenic escape mutants
rationale: Members cover the destruction-complex phosphorylation of beta-catenin and the CTNNB1, AXIN and GSK3B mutants that evade it, unlike neighbours on receptor-level Wnt events, APC/AXIN degradation or TCF transcription.

qualifier: V-ATPase, coupled to melanin pigmentation
name: V-ATPase organelle acidification and melanosome pigmentation
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-dependent acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles with melanin synthesis, pigment granule maturation and MITF pigmentation genes, unlike neighbours on CO2/pH buffering, melanosome assembly or UV response.

qualifier: Chk1/Chk2 inhibition of cyclin B-CDK1
name: Chk1/Chk2 G2/M checkpoint inhibition of cyclin B-CDK1
rationale: All members concern the G2/M replication checkpoint in which Chk1/Chk2 inactivate cyclin B-CDK1, unlike neighbours on E2F/G1-S transcription, replication stress or p53 regulation.
